facts.fact: Expertise France's project page, published 2026-02-17, says its EU-funded project (running August 2024 to August 2027) works with ESTDEV to improve and align Botswana's National Interoperability framework, standards, guidelines and tools, and lists a 'harmonised and operational national interoperability framework for e-government services' as an expected result; the page does not say the framework has been adopted or issued, and its date is the page's published date.

note: carried from interoperability by its own text; no document opened
